title: 第17章 好好活着不好吗第18章 界中界
slug: 你一个武夫谁让你炼剑的
lines: 闻声，南家众人全都吓得心头一颤！
此时场中之人皆是频频转头看向四处，前几日南家为了一个三境武夫女婿放弃了刚刚觉醒真龙剑意的杨傲，此事在鹿云城可是人尽皆知。
如今杨傲成为了灵剑学院长老的亲传弟子，身份地位鱼跃龙门，这明显是要一雪前耻了啊！
“怎么，现在知道怕了，当缩头乌龟了？”杨傲的声音再次响起。
秦关突然站了起来，他看向杨傲：“找你爷爷何事？”
听到回应，场中所有人齐齐看向秦关那边。
“小畜生，你是他爷爷，我是你什么！”杨红梅突然破口大骂。
“哈哈！”
知道关系辈分的人全都笑的前仰后合。
“小杂种，那日我剑道不稳让你侥幸获胜，这一次我要亲手宰了你，过来一战！”杨傲剑剑尖指着秦关嚣张道。
“既然你一心求死，我若是再不成全你，阎王都要气晕了。”秦关说完朝着杨傲那边走去。
见状，南柔急忙跟了上去。
南云起也急忙起身，带着南家十余人紧随其后。
“很好，都到齐了！”看到南云起他们，杨傲笑了起来。
“傲儿，看在姑姑的面子上饶了南家吧！”杨红梅看向杨傲求情道。
杨傲突然面目狰狞，气骂道：
“你闭嘴，那日南云起都说休了你，让你滚出南家，你还死皮赖脸的赖在南家，真是丢人现眼！”
闻言，杨红梅一愣，旋即恼怒道：
“我可是你姑姑，这么多年我一直把你当亲儿子一样对待，你怎么能如此羞辱我！”
杨傲手中的剑指向南云起冷声道：
“那好，看在你的面子上饶了南家也可以，让南云起给我跪下磕头认错，我今日便放了南家！”
听到杨傲要让自己父亲下跪，南乔气道：
“当年你走投无路是我父亲收留了你，这些年我父亲待你如己出，从没亏待你半分，现在得势开始翻脸了，真是个白眼狼！”
“闭嘴！”
杨傲怒喝：
“秦关杀了我表弟，你父亲向着他，放弃了我，你怎么不说？”
南乔正要说什么秦关突然不耐烦道：“别废话，马上我就送你下去跟你表弟见面。”
“呵呵。”
苍元看向秦关淡淡一笑：
“今日老夫倒要看看你如何杀我徒儿。”
秦关看向苍元骂道：
“你个老东西，要是活的不耐烦我不介意连你一块带着。”
听到秦关的话，场内众人皆是深吸一口气，南家这女婿当真是狂妄啊，连灵剑学院的长老都不放在眼里。
苍元眼神眯了起来！
唰唰唰！
灵剑学院的十余名弟子也纷纷拔出长剑，一股冰冷的杀气瞬间覆盖向秦关。
“仗势欺人，枉为自诩正派的灵剑学院！”
南云起冷哼一声，旋即做好了战斗准备，他虽然顾及家族，但是真遇到事也不会怂。
萧家老祖萧云冷哼一声，他看向南云起：
“南云起，给你脸了，一个三流小家族也敢冒犯灵剑学院，老夫劝你最好别冲动，否则我萧家不介意让你南家在鹿云城消失！”
话音落下，萧家几十名弟子噌的一下全站了起来。
见状，周围一些家族子弟看到要打架全都后退开来，让出一大片空地。
content_en:
Hearing the sound, everyone in the Nan family was frightened and their hearts trembled!
At this time, everyone in the field frequently turned their heads and looked around. A few days ago, the Nan family gave up Yang Ao, who had just awakened the True Dragon Sword Intent, for a third-level warrior son-in-law. This matter was well known in Luyun City.
Now that Yang Ao has become the direct disciple of the elder of the Spirit Sword Academy, his status has skyrocketed. This is obviously a way to avenge his previous shame!
"Why, now that you know you're afraid, are you acting like a coward?" Yang Ao's voice sounded again.
Qin Guan suddenly stood up and looked at Yang Ao: "What do you want from your grandfather?"
Upon hearing the response, everyone in the venue looked towards Qinguan.
"Little beast, you are his grandfather, what am I to you!" Yang Hongmei suddenly yelled.
"Haha!"
Everyone who knew the seniority of the relationship burst into laughter.
"Little bastard, you won by chance because of my unstable swordsmanship that day. This time I will kill you with my own hands. Come and fight!" Yang Aojian pointed the tip of his sword at Qin Guan and said arrogantly.
"Since you want to die, if I don't help you, the King of Hell will be so angry that he will faint." After Qin Guan finished speaking, he walked towards Yang Ao.
Seeing this, Nanrou hurriedly followed.
Nan Yunqi also stood up in a hurry, followed by more than ten people from the Nan family.
"Very good, everyone is here!" Yang Ao laughed when he saw Nan Yunqi and the others.
"Aoer, for the sake of my aunt, please spare the Nan family!" Yang Hongmei looked at Yang Ao and begged.
Yang Ao suddenly looked ferocious and cursed angrily:
"Shut up, Nan Yunqi said that day that he would divorce you and get you out of the Nan family, but you still stayed in the Nan family shamelessly. It's really embarrassing!"
Hearing this, Yang Hongmei was stunned for a moment, and then said angrily:
"I am your aunt. I have treated you like my own son for so many years. How could you humiliate me like this!"
The sword in Yang Ao's hand pointed at Nan Yunqi and said coldly:
"Well, for your sake, you can spare the Nan family. Let Nan Yunqi kneel down and kowtow to admit his mistake. I will let the Nan family go today!"
Hearing that Yang Ao wanted his father to kneel down, Nan Qiao said angrily:
"It was my father who took you in when you were desperate. Over the years, my father has treated you like his own child and has never treated you unfairly. Now that he has gained the upper hand, he has turned against you. He is really a white-eyed wolf!"
"Shut up!"
Yang Ao shouted angrily:
"Qin Guan killed my cousin, and your father gave up on me because of him. Why didn't you say anything?"
"You..."
When Nan Qiao was about to say something, Qin Guan suddenly said impatiently: "Stop talking nonsense, I will send you down to meet your cousin right away."
"Haha."
Cang Yuan looked at Qin Guan and smiled faintly:
"Today I want to see how you kill my disciple."
Qin Guan looked at Cang Yuan and cursed:
"You old thing, if you get tired of living, I won't mind taking you with me."
Hearing Qin Guan's words, everyone in the venue took a deep breath. This son-in-law of the Nan family was really arrogant. Even the elders of the Spirit Sword Academy didn't look down on him.
Cang Yuan's eyes narrowed!
Swish, swish, swish!
More than a dozen disciples from the Spirit Sword Academy also drew out their long swords, and a cold murderous aura instantly enveloped Qin Guan.
"The Spirit Sword Academy that claims to be upright is in vain for using its power to bully others!"
Nan Yunqi snorted coldly and immediately prepared for battle. Although he took care of his family, he would not give up if he encountered trouble.
Xiao Yun, the ancestor of the Xiao family, snorted coldly and looked at Nan Yunqi:
"Nanyunqi, I'm sorry for you. A third-rate small family dares to offend the Spirit Sword Academy. I advise you not to be impulsive, otherwise our Xiao family will not mind letting your Nan family disappear in Luyun City!"
After the words fell, dozens of Xiao family disciples suddenly stood up.
Seeing this, some of the family members around them all backed away when they saw a fight, leaving a large open space.
